exam_name: NCIE — NetApp Certified Implementation Engineer: Data Protection
passing_score_scale: Scaled score; approximately 70% passing for most exams

testing_centers.notes: All NetApp exams are delivered exclusively through Pearson VUE. Online proctored (OnVUE) and test center options both available.

id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID required. Name on ID must match registration exactly.
exam_rules: No personal items, notes, or reference materials permitted. Online proctored via Pearson VUE OnVUE: must be alone in room, no second monitors. All candidates must accept the NetApp Certification Program Agreement before scheduling.
renewal_options: Certifications are valid for 2 years. Recertification requires passing the current version of the same exam or a higher-level exam in the same track before expiration. NetApp does not currently offer maintenance exams separate from the full exam.

retake_policy.notes: 14-day waiting period between failed attempts. Full exam fee applies for each retake attempt. Candidates who pass may not retake the exam to improve their score.

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the NetApp NCIE Data Protection certification covering ONTAP data management and cloud integration across 65 exam questions at Pearson VUE.
editorial.overview: The NetApp NCIE Data Protection certification exam evaluates candidates on ONTAP Data Management, Storage Architecture and Design, SAN/NAS Configuration, Data Protection and SnapVault, Cloud Integration across AWS, Azure, and GCP, alongside Performance and Troubleshooting. Candidates must complete a total of 65 questions at authorized Pearson VUE testing centers to successfully earn this professional credential. This exam validates the technical proficiency required to manage complex storage environments effectively.
editorial.who_should_take: This certification explicitly targets enterprise storage professionals who design, configure, and manage complex storage architectures, data protection workflows, and cloud-integrated infrastructures using advanced NetApp technologies in professional environments.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review official technical documentation for ONTAP deployment, data protection workflows, and configuration guides. Focus study efforts on ONTAP Data Management, Storage Architecture and Design, SAN/NAS Configuration, Data Protection and SnapVault, Cloud Integration (AWS, Azure, GCP), and Performance and Troubleshooting. Utilize official resources to master the technical requirements for the 65 questions presented on the exam to ensure full readiness for the testing environment.

This specific domain focuses on Storage Architecture and Design principles and related technical concepts within reliable enterprise storage environments and modern data centers to ensure optimal performance and robust system design.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The exam format consists of exactly 65 questions delivered via Pearson VUE. Ensure you arrive fully prepared for multiple choice and multiple response formats. Check with NetApp for the current certification path.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The certification exam consists of exactly 65 questions presented in a linear, fixed-form test format delivered securely through Pearson VUE testing centers across the globe for all candidates.
The exam utilizes a scaled score system where approximately 70% passing performance is required to successfully achieve certification for standard candidates taking the test at authorized centers.

faq.question_title: How long is the certification validity?
faq.answer_text: The earned professional certification remains valid for a total duration of 2 years, after which a renewal or recertification process is required to maintain active status for professionals.

faq.question_title: How much does the exam cost?
faq.answer_text: The standard exam registration price is set at $250 USD when registering directly through official NetApp certification booking channels and authorized partner portals for all global test takers.
